header: The All-India Consumer Price Index for Industrial Workers and the Dearness Allowance of SAIL employees worked out from it. From the top: the latest index and how it moved; the graph of the year (from the same month a year back to the latest month, the span of the other one-year charts); the DA of the quarter in force and of the next, three figures; the quarters of the year in a table with the work of each; the formula step by step; a calculator for a basic pay. The DA is the CPSE "IDA pattern" of the 2017 pay scales, revised every three months (src/lib/live/aicpi.ts has the orders it comes from and the test against the announced rates). I work everything out here, in the browser, from the record the server reads from the Labour Bureau; what is typed into the calculator is not sent anywhere. I make the card say what is and is not established: the formula and the rates are those of the Department of Public Enterprises' orders; that SAIL pays exactly these is from the guidelines its executives are under and its 2021 wage agreement (reported), and SAIL's own circular is the authority.

behaviours: the card says what AICPI-IW is, who publishes it and that the DA of SAIL's employees follows it and is revised every three months; the latest is Sep 2026: 155.5, up 1.1 points on Aug 2026, 5.6% above Sep 2025
the next index and its day: Oct 2026 is due on 30 November 2026 (the last day of the next month)
the graph is of the year: Sep 2025 to Sep 2026, 13 monthly figures, with the first month's figure (147.3) in the Start box and the latest (155.5)
the quarter in force: 59.1% from 1 October 2026 (June to August 2026, 59.06%) with the DPE order that announced it
the next quarter is an expectation: 61.5% from 1 January 2027 if October and November stand at 155.5 (Sep 2026 to Nov 2026, 1 of 3 months published, 61.48%), and a projection, not an announcement
one point of the index adds 1.04% of DA, and two points about 2.1%

the table of quarters: 1 Jan 2026 53.4%, 1 Apr 54.1%, 1 Jul 55.7%, 1 Oct 59.1% (each with the order's rate ticked, as the formula gives the same) and 1 Jan 2027 61.5% marked expected, with no order yet
the formula is written out with its constants and says that the figure is rounded to the nearest tenth, not cut (59.06% is 59.1%)

it names the three months of each quarter, the order of 3 August 2017 as the source of the link point, and says that the factor 2.88 is not printed in the orders and is the one that gives the rates they announce
it says, from the data, that the formula gives the order's rate in 4 of the 4 quarters of the table that have one, and names them
the work for the quarter in force is laid out line by line: average 153.17, × 2.88 = 441.12, − 277.33 = 163.79, ÷ 277.33 × 100 = 59.06%, DA 59.1%
the calculator: a basic pay of 56,100 gives DA ₹33,155 at 59.1% and ₹34,502 at the expected 61.5%, each with the pay added
an empty or silly basic pay shows the instruction, not figures; 'the pay slip is the authority' and 'nothing is sent' are said

it says what the figures rest on: DPE's orders for the 2017 pay scales; SAIL's executives under those guidelines; the 22 October 2021 agreement reported to give the non-executives the same; SAIL's own circular is the authority; no extra factor was found or invented; orders are read from DPE's site, with the hand list only for pictures
nothing of the Central Government's DA is on the card (it is not SAIL's)
with DPE's orders from the site, the quarter in force offers its order to open and the table's ticks are links to the PDFs
with no orders from the site the card has no link to a PDF
a new order of 1 January 2027 that the site gives with its text is shown by itself: quarter in force, its OM number and date, its link
an order the site lists whose rate nobody has read (a picture not in my list) is named with its link and never given a rate: the big figure stays a dash
when an order's rate differs from the formula, the order's rate is the one in force (59.3%), the worked-out one is named, and the check says plainly that the formula does not give it
and the calculator then takes the order's rate (56,100 at 59.3% is ₹33,267)
the card asks the server every six hours (the index changes once a month)
'aicpi da' and its like open the card
a line with words that are not the card's does not open it (da vinci, a tyre), and the other live cards keep their words (SAIL's share price is still the markets card)
the sample questions are the card's own words
a line that asks for inflation or the CPI opens the CPI tab; the DA words (aicpi, cpi-iw, da, sail da) keep the dearness allowance tab
the window's headline covers all three features (AICPI, SAIL DA, inflation), not only the DA
